19.critic_justification: The cited evidence is accurate. feature/games/xo/domain/impl/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml lines 11-16 declare ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION and ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION with no maxSdkVersion, and lines 9-10 give NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES the neverForLocation flag. GamesFragment.kt line 50 requests NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES on API 33+ and ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION only below it. With targetSdk 36 and that flag, the WifiP2pManager calls in WifiDirectImpl.kt do not need location on API 33+. NsdManager, used by the other XO path, needs no location permission either. minSdk is 31, so location is needed only on API 31-32. No project manifest other than this one declares the permissions, and no LocationManager, FusedLocation, getLastKnownLocation, requestLocationUpdates, SSID or scan-result access was found. Severity is lowered to SUGGESTION because this is over-declared scope, not a confirmed violation: the permission backs a live Wi-Fi Direct feature on API 31-32, it is never requested at runtime on API 33+, and no location data is accessed or sent anywhere. The worker's own evidence says the same.
19.recommendation: In feature/games/xo/domain/impl/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml add android:maxSdkVersion="32" to both location <uses-permission> entries and remove android:required="true". Keep ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION next to FINE, because Android 12 expects both to be declared. Then update feature/games/xo/demo/src/main/kotlin/n7/ad2/xo/demo/AppPermission.kt, which adds ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION and NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES unconditionally at lines 11-12: with the limit in place FINE can never be granted on API 33+, so allPermissionGranted() stays false and the demo prompts on every run. Use the same SDK check as GamesFragment.kt line 50. Finally, inspect the merged release manifest to confirm no library re-adds the location permissions without the limit.
